Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You emphasise proving your reliability, yet your proposed quality commitment allows more defects than your recorded performance—it seems you want to build confidence without overcommitting. We want a dependable partnership grounded in measurable defect reduction and proportionate accountability. How will you substantiate a tighter, binding quality commitment with a full root-cause and corrective-action report?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). We understand cash flow matters to you: we will pay every invoice reliably on the agreed day. Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (800 ppm, EUR 150 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit; 300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. We hear you on the quality and can agree to the 800 ppm and 150 EUR chargeback to show we're serious about improving. To make this tighter quality work on our end, we can drop the price to 46.50 EUR. You mentioned paying on time - that's really important for us right now, so we need to count on you sticking to the agreed days. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Our current offer is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 800 ppm and a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint: €46.50 per unit. For info, our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) - quality commitment and price 2027
messages.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz team,

Thank you for moving. Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -17.1% from 2025-02 to 2026-02 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-02, idx:PPI-D351@2026-02).

Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 94% of your invoices late, on average 10 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 10 days earlier than you are used to.

We propose EUR 43.57 per piece, 300 ppm, no chargeback (term sheet attached).

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
